description: The agent ids that produce the estimates in combined_numbers_of_record.json, one list per population. The run is frozen to these ids by default; --no-freeze recomputes the cohort from the cache and is an audit mode, not a publication mode. Every declared id is verified readable before the analysis starts and pinned by content hash, so the estimate is a property of the study rather than of the machine it ran on.

definition.abusive: roster_v2 role abusive_share: agents sending more than a quarter of their requests to paths on the published exploit-path list, less agents individually hand-verified as human.
definition.verified: roster_v2 role verified_human: the hand-curated human control arm.
definition.pothuman: roster_v2 role pothuman: the larger model-selected sensitivity arm.
definition.eligibility: a cached daily series of at least 20 active observations; agents failing that criterion are recorded in combined_numbers_of_record.json:excluded with their reason.

input_verification: This file declares WHICH agents are in each cohort; `input_pins.json` declares WHICH BYTES they carry.
